description.value: Chronic Tacos is a Southern California-founded fast-casual Mexican grill franchise with a Vancouver Waterfront location steps from the convention centre and harbour. The menu covers tacos, burritos, bowls, quesadillas, and sides, with online ordering and catering available. Both indoor and outdoor seating are on offer, making it a convenient refuelling stop for cyclists riding along the waterfront.
